scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent an unwanted annual FloraID Lab renewal while preserving access through the final HORT-218 identification practical.
Emerging Need: A renewal notice creates a future $84 charge, but immediate termination would remove a tool still needed for the scheduled practical; confirmed completion later removes that tradeoff.
Decision Context: Stored account instructions supply the authorized cancellation route, subscription reference, and standing preference; course-use state and the vendor cutoff determine when ending access is both safe and effective.
Consequence: Action in the valid interval avoids an optional expense; after the cutoff, the pending charge is locked to settle despite offering no further coursework benefit.

parameter.subject: Upcoming renewal for FI-LM-218-26
parameter.body: FloraID Lab student plan FI-LM-218-26 remains set to renew for 12 months at $84 on Friday, September 11. A nonrenewal notice must be received by 4:00 p.m. ET on Thursday, September 10. Any accepted cancellation before then ends app access immediately. We expect to place a pending renewal authorization after the scheduled course-use period. No reply is required.

parameter.title: HORT-218 final woody-plant identification practical
parameter.description: Final supervised identification practical. Active FloraID Lab access is required for station check-in and must remain available until the submission window closes.

parameter.content: The HORT-218 practical submission window has closed, and your station receipt is recorded. Today was the course's final assessed use of FloraID Lab. The remaining reflection work uses exported screenshots and does not require an active account.

parameter.description: Annual student-plan renewal authorization scheduled to capture on 2026-09-11; an accepted nonrenewal before the vendor cutoff will release it.

parameter.subject: Renewal FI-LM-218-26 is now locked
parameter.body: The 4:00 p.m. ET nonrenewal cutoff has passed, and no cancellation notice is on file. The pending $84 authorization is now locked for capture on Friday, September 11. A cancellation notice received after the cutoff cannot prevent or reverse this annual charge.
